topPRs.title: ci: standardize image builds on factory plan action
topPRs.author: falcorocks
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Migrate `.github/workflows/build-images.yaml` to factory's unified `plan` action and bump the factory pin to `e7c939d0effb3c1a49937dc11b2d490694ede41c`.
- Collapse the previous `local` / `fork` dual-job split into a single `build` job. The factory `docker.yaml` now resolves the effective registry internally (canonical on in-repo events, `ttl.sh/${github.sha}` on fork PRs) and gates GCP OIDC auth, registry login, and attestation steps on `is_fork_pr == 'false'`. A single job with `contents: read`, `id-token: write`, `attestations: write` works for both contexts.
- Drop the `${{ matrix.x || 'default' }}` shadow defaults and the matrix fields whose values are not set in `.github/images.json` (`mode`, `bake_file`, `skip_arm64`, `context`, `dockerfile`); the plan action populates the remaining fields cleanly and the reusable workflow has the correct defaults.

## Test plan

- [ ] CI passes on this PR (plan + build matrix succeed for the affected images)
- [ ] Verify built images are signed and attested on merge to `main`
